description: Build catalog browsing screens in SwiftUI. Implement grid layouts using LazyVGrid (tvOS: 6 columns, iPad: 4-5 columns, iPhone: 2-3 columns). Add filtering by genre/year/rating, sorting options, infinite scroll with pagination. Integrate Rust SDK catalog service for Stremio addon browsing. Support tvOS focus engine and iOS scroll views.
